title: Find the names and artists of cards that are available in Russian and have
question: Find the names and artists of cards that are available in Russian and have a borderless design. Only include artists who have illustrated more than one such card.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049" AS name, T1."XCL_002" AS artist
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_082"
WHERE T1."XCL_005" = 'borderless'
  AND T2."XCL_077" = 'Russian'
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT T3."XCL_002"
    FROM cards AS T3
    INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T4 ON T3."XCL_072" = T4."XCL_082"
    WHERE T3."XCL_005" = 'borderless'
      AND T4."XCL_077" = 'Russian'
    GROUP BY T3."XCL_002"
    HAVING COUNT(T3."XCL_001") > 1
  )
